messages:
sophie: Heads up — customer asks (AcmeHealth + Shoply) pushed batching/caching/quantization recommendations to the top. Need to decide what we can ship in the next sprint vs. what goes to pilot. TL;DR: customers want fast guidance + eval-triggered alerts.
ryan: high level: agree. We should treat this as a 2-lane launch: 1) lightweight advisor (docs + API flags + basic heuristics) for GA, 2) advanced recommendations (model/quant profiles, adaptive batching) for pilot.
anika: +1. Also we need concrete launch criteria for the advisor lane — otherwise sales will promise it. Suggest minimal acceptance: docs + SDK snippets, 3 heuristic rules, and evaluation alert plumbing.
tom: can we define the 3 heuristics? My suggestion: 
- detect tail latency patterns and recommend smaller batch sizes
- suggest prefix caching when >30% token reuse
- recommend int8 quantization only when eval quality delta < 2% (by our eval suite)
(quick numbers to iterate on)
sophie: those are sensible. For eval-alert thresholds we should be explicit: default SLOs and alert triggers. Proposal:
- token-gen p95 latency degradation > 20% vs baseline -> eval alert
- top-1 output drift (embedding cosine) > 0.07 on seed prompts -> eval alert
- pilot-only: accuracy/regression > 1.5% absolute -> paged to oncall
elaine: ops/console implications: we need telemetry hooks now. ops-bot can we wire a manifest to collect baseline metrics for each model route?
ops-bot: scheduled: create baseline-metrics collection ticket and a tracing tag for routes, ETA 3 working days. Will post PR link. :robot_face:
ryan: rollout plan thought: GA advisor = docs + API + UI hints + non-blocking alerts (email only). Pilot = in-console recommendations + one-click apply + canary on 10% traffic + automatic rollback if eval regressions detected.
anika: acceptance test checklist for GA advisor (proposal):
- SDK sample works end-to-end
- docs + quickstart updated
- 3 heuristics validated on internal benchmark (perf + regen checks)
- eval-trigger paths exercise-able via CLI
(If any of these fail -> delay)
tom: timeline ask: can eng-team deliver advisor lane in 3 sprints if we scope to the minimal heuristics and a dry-run telemetry? Feels tight but doable.
sophie: ok capture decisions: 1) two-lane launch (GA advisor vs Pilot advanced) 2) heuristics as tom proposed 3) concrete eval alert thresholds as above 4) ops to provide baseline telemetry 5) acceptance checklist in PR template. I’ll book a 30m scope-handoff tomorrow 10am.
elaine: adding dependency: we need pricing note for Dedicated customers (reserved capacity batching recommendations may change billing). Finance wants a short brief.
ryan: noted — will draft pricing brief after we freeze heuristics.
sophie: thanks all. If no objections I’ll move the advisor lane into `sprint-scope` board tonight and tag owners. :thumbsup:
ryan: no objections from me.
anika: same.
ops-bot: reminder set: follow-up sync in 7 days.
